title: X-AQA: Unifying Action Quality Assessment with Multimodal Large Language Models and Multi-Domain Learning
abstract: arXiv:2611.28548v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Action Quality Assessment (AQA) aims to evaluate the quality of human actions, yet existing methods are predominantly developed and evaluated on individual datasets with different task formulations and assessment criteria. We introduce X-AQA, the first unified training and evaluation framework for general-purpose AQA with multimodal large language models (MLLMs). We construct X-AQA-40K, a training corpus comprising 40,163 samples from 22 data sources across four domains: competitive sports, fitness exercises, rehabilitation, and general skills. We convert heterogeneous annotations into a unified question-answering format, incorporating dataset-specific annotation guidelines and official scoring rules when available. Using this corpus, we fine-tune Qwen3.5-9B to develop a single MLLM capable of handling diverse AQA tasks. translated_title: X-AQA：基于多模态大语言模型与多领域学习的统一动作质量评估
translated_abstract: 动作质量评估旨在评估人类动作的质量，然而现有方法主要是在各自独立的数据集上进行开发和评估的，这些数据集具有不同的任务形式和评分标准。我们提出了X-AQA，这是首个基于多模态大语言模型（MLLM）的通用动作质量评估统一训练与评估框架。我们构建了X-AQA-40K训练语料库，包含来自竞技体育、健身锻炼、康复训练和通用技能四个领域共22个数据源的40,163个样本。我们将异构的标注转换为统一的问题-回答格式，并在可用时纳入特定数据集的标注指南和官方评分规则。利用该语料库，我们对Qwen3.5-9B进行微调，开发出一个能够处理多样化AQA任务的单一多模态大语言模型。我们进一步建立了X-AQA-Bench基准，用于评估模型在训练中所涵盖数据集上的分布内性能……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出首个基于多模态大语言模型的通用动作质量评估统一框架X-AQA，通过构建涵盖竞技体育、健身、康复和通用技能四个领域、4万余样本的X-AQA-40K语料库及X-AQA-Bench基准，用单一微调模型即可统一处理多样化的动作质量评估任务。
